proposed.title: X-Men: Apocalypse
proposed.text: Seeing Apocalypse attack Mystique, Storm turns on him and helps the X-Men destroy him. She stays at the rebuilt school to train as one of the new X-Men.
cases: FX-018 The Battle of Cairo (X-Men: Apocalypse)

changes.evidence: The file ends with Storm still serving Apocalypse (At large), but in X-Men: Apocalypse 'Lehnsherr and Ororo turn on En Sabah Nur and keep him occupied physically with Scott's help' while Jean incinerates him; afterward 'McCoy and Raven train the new X-Men recruits: Scott, Jean, Ororo, Kurt, and Peter.' A change of sides with no record.

owner_calls.question: k3 sets the whole group to Deceased, but in the same record only Angel dies: Psylocke escapes, and Storm and Magneto defect and survive. What status should the group file end on?
options: Keep Deceased (the Horsemen as a group are finished)
Change to Missing (group broken up, Psylocke at large)
Change to Allied (two of the four end on the heroes' side)
owner_calls.evidence: Wikipedia plot: 'Psylocke manages to jump safely and escape, but Angel is killed in the plane crash. Lehnsherr and Ororo turn on En Sabah Nur...' Only one of the four Horsemen dies.

owner_calls.question: The file's name and team are 'The Omegas'. The film's plot never names Callisto's gang; the label comes from the fan wiki (inspired by the comics' Morlocks). Is 'The Omegas' said or shown on screen in X-Men: The Last Stand, or should the file use a plain description (e.g. 'Callisto's gang')?
options: Keep 'The Omegas' (owner confirms it is on screen)
Rename to a plain description such as 'Callisto's gang'
owner_calls.evidence: Wikipedia's plot calls them only 'Callisto, and several other mutants'; the X-Men Movies Wiki 'Omegas' page is a wiki team label ('The Omegas are heavily inspired by the Morlocks').
